correctness.rationale: Greedy minimal complete-alphabet blocks compute the index: their completion letters followed by a letter missing from the remainder give a nonembedded target. In a proper word with j letters seen, j−1 legal repeats and q−j acquisitions give the stage products. The first position contributes q rather than q−1 choices, including the correct separate empty word. Under uniform legal transitions, the acquisition hazards depend only on j, so strong Markov restart gives independent geometric delays and independent arch lengths. This yields the stated moments, the CLT for q≥3 and the ternary binomial survival law; for q=2 the length is deterministically two. For the bounded moment errors, it is 1−φ that has a simple zero at 1: the differentiated renewal series have poles of orders two and three. With s=1−z and a=E[L(L−1)]/2, the first moment series starts μ⁻¹s⁻²+(a/μ²−1)s⁻¹, and the second factorial moment series starts 2μ⁻²s⁻³+(4a/μ³−4/μ)s⁻². Coefficient extraction and centering give (2a+μ−μ²)n/μ³+O(1); span one and exponential moments isolate the dominant singularity. At length qk all arches are permutations and each later first letter must avoid the last letter of the previous arch. Independent finite check: generate every proper host for q=2,3,4,5 with n≤8,10,8,5 respectively; test all targets up to floor(n/q) by a forward subsequence scan. This counted 17,914 hosts, 157,505 pattern tests and matched all 15 nontrivial ternary survival cases tested. At q=3,n=9 the exact-index counts were (6,138,528,96), and at q=4,n=8 they were (1524,6792,432). The frozen verify.py is an additional documented replay path, inspected but not executed; finite checks do not establish the asymptotics.

evidence: Adamson counts and ranks unrestricted universal words; Adamson et al. treat counting on regular languages; Barker et al., Proposition 10, identifies the index with the number of arches.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The proper-host condition is regular, so general algorithms compute fixed-length counts and hence exact-index differences. The inspected general results are not the explicit proper-word rational and renewal formula; actual exact coverage is the mirror.

evidence: The mirror gives the same μ_q, v_q and renewal limits and gives the kth-arch generating functions. It does not spell out the ternary binomial tail.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: From its ternary generating function the normalized arch law is z³/(2−z), i.e. 2+Geom(1/2). Thus its kth-epoch convolution gives the exact binomial tail, an elementary reformulation of already specified coefficients.

evidence: Mirror offsets 0–4877 and 4877–8703 give the labeled adjacency-distinct host distribution with E_q=(q−1)!z^(q−1)/∏_{h=0}^{q−2}(1−hz) and H=Σ_{j<q}E_j/(1−(j−1)z). Its series is (1+qzH+uzE_q)/(1−u(q−1)zE_q).
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Substitute A=(q−1)zE_q and B=1+(q−1)zH in the frozen expression and collect its numerator over 1−uA. The identity and model agree, including n=0 and all q≥2.

originality.rationale: A distinct indexed result gives the same proper-host model, full all-q distribution, ternary rational law, renewal constants and Gaussian law, and shortest-host enumeration. This is a failure to establish a distinct mathematical finding against existing coverage, not a finding of who derived it first. The mirror path date is later than the frozen record date, and neither the relationship nor priority is established. The binomial-tail phrasing absent from the mirror follows by summing its exact distribution (or by expanding the kth power of its ternary arch generating function); it does not supply a distinct remainder.
residual_risks: The relationship and priority order of the two distinct records are not established by the visible path dates.
Earlier literature comparison was targeted, not an exhaustive priority search.

value.rationale: As mathematics, this is a useful exact solution for a natural regular host language: it replaces generic automata counting with a uniform closed form and a tractable probabilistic law for a canonical constrained-word model. That value does not imply distinctness, and the elementary ternary-tail rewrite alone would not rescue the covered contribution.
